verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static-site documentation framework, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint; the probes found no llms.txt, docs.md or OpenAPI spec, and the documented CLI covers site building and versioning only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
